name: Energy
pullQuote: Energy assets are judged on the days they are not interesting at all.
overview: The energy business spans power, oil and gas — sectors that share a characteristic the group takes seriously: the cost of interruption is carried by everyone downstream, not by the asset alone. Reliability is therefore the operating measure, ahead of efficiency and well ahead of novelty.

Work in this sector runs on long horizons and slow feedback. Decisions taken when an asset is commissioned determine what it costs to run for the rest of its life, and by the time that becomes visible the decision is expensive to revisit.

approach.heading: Uneventfulness as an objective
body: The measure of an energy asset is the proportion of its life during which nothing noteworthy happens. That sounds like an absence of ambition and is in fact the harder thing to engineer — it means designing for conditions that occur rarely, and maintaining against failures that have not happened yet.

Maintenance is planned rather than triggered. Deferring work because an asset is still running is the most common way to convert a small scheduled cost into a large unscheduled one, so the schedule is treated as the commitment.
